summary: Lychee is a grid and album-based photo management system designed to run on your own infrastructure. It provides a web interface for organising, browsing, and sharing your digital image collections.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a dedicated, lightweight web application specifically for managing photo albums without relying on third-party cloud services.
watchOut: You will need to manage your own storage volumes for large image libraries, and performance may depend heavily on your server's hardware when generating thumbnails.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your photo storage and a separate database backend to maintain application state.
